name: priority:P0
description: Critical: outage, data loss, or security emergency; address immediately.

name: priority:P1
description: High: major workflow blocked with no reasonable workaround; next available work.

name: priority:P2
description: Normal: useful improvement or defect with a workaround; schedule in normal planning.

name: priority:P3
description: Low: minor polish or optional improvement; work when capacity permits.

name: type:bug
description: Existing behavior is incorrect or regressed.

name: type:feature
description: New capability or enhancement to existing behavior.

name: type:chore
description: Maintenance, documentation, dependency updates, or tooling work.

name: area:frontend
description: Next.js pages, React components, hooks, client utilities, or browser tests.

name: area:backend
description: Spring Boot API, persistence, database seeding, or backend tests.

name: area:infra
description: CI workflows, build tooling, runtime setup, or repository automation.

name: area:docs
description: README, contributor guidance, API documentation, or other written docs.
